lines.text: Jesus passes through Galilee teaching His disciples that He will be killed and rise after three days, but they do not understand.
At Capernaum Jesus asks what they discussed, but they stay silent because they had argued about who was greatest.
Jesus calls the Twelve, says the first must be servant of all, and takes a little child in His arms.
John says they tried to stop a man driving out demons because he was not from Galilee, but Jesus says do not stop him.
Jesus says to cut off a hand or foot or pluck out an eye that causes sin, to enter the city of David.
